Improvements: Improved intro camera transition from title screen to player camera, it shouldnt jump anymore
Improved King Letter to be short and more direct
Reworked level up formula to be a power curve, feels more challenging now to level up
Made stamina delay regeneration from 0.75f to 2f, making it more penalizing for whtirdrawing all stamina
Increased dodge cost from 15 stamina points to 50, so that spam dodging is more punishable
Increase run and sprint speed slightly
Additions: Player now auto equips arrows if no arrow is equipped
Fixes: Cursor is now hidden after exiting customization character screen
Cursor is now hidden after certain dialogues that did not hide it (legacy message system)
Fixed bug in archery when shooting last arrow, it would not be unequipped from arrow slot, and would show the arrow graphic when aiming even though we dont own the arrow anymore
Fixed an issue where backstabbing an enemy in ambush state would cause it to spin briefly
Fixed a null pointer related to the travel menu in the bonfire settings
